surfaces.name: Agentic Orchestrator desktop app (Electron; macOS and Linux)

claims.answer: Electron desktop app for macOS (universal DMG) and Linux (x64/arm64 AppImage and .deb) with a Go agentico server/CLI; the app can attach to a server on another machine by connection string. No Windows build, no mobile or browser client, and no editor extension.

scope.plan: Free, open source (Apache-2.0); user pays provider subscriptions or API usage

desktop_os.answer: Assets are exactly a macOS universal DMG, Linux x64/arm64 AppImages and amd64/arm64 .deb packages; no Windows asset; macOS releases are not yet Developer ID signed per README.

cli.answer: `agentico` launches the desktop app; `agentico server` runs a headless server; `agentico api` makes authenticated REST calls.

editor_extensions.answer: Bounded search found no IDE extension.

cross_device_continuity.answer: State lives in the server; the app can attach to a server on another machine; no web or mobile continuation.

limitations: Desktop only; the REST server is reachable from other machines only as a bearer-token network server.

claims.answer: Three co-equal provider CLIs run each phase: Claude Code (>=2.1.81), Codex (>=0.153.2) and OpenCode (>=1.17.9, routing many backends incl. local Ollama); per-phase model selection, mixed providers within one feature. The product drives each CLI through its protocol; no user-defined adapter exists.

evidence.title: Agentic Orchestrator README
evidence.locator: intro; The Feature Lifecycle; Pipeline Profiles; Worktree Isolation; Configuration; Launch Flags
evidence.finding: Desktop-first AI development workflow orchestrator (Electron app plus agentico Go server/CLI): per-feature worktrees, KB, inquiry, research, design, roadmap and phase planning with plan critics, implementation, Final Review and publish via gh; Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode providers; Apache-2.0.

evidence.title: Desktop release, updates and diagnostics
evidence.locator: The resulting desktop assets are exactly
evidence.finding: Desktop assets are exactly a macOS universal DMG, Linux x64/arm64 AppImages and amd64/arm64 .deb packages plus a signed desktop-release.json; staged in-app updates on DMG and AppImage; releases cut locally by the operator.

evidence.title: Connecting the desktop app to a server on another machine
evidence.locator: Running the server on the host; Pasting the connection string
evidence.finding: agentico server --listen binds a network address with plain HTTP plus a bearer token and prints an agentico:// connection string; the desktop app attaches via Settings > Servers; trusted-network or SSH tunnel expected.

evidence.title: Observability and fleet telemetry
evidence.locator: intro; Outcome definitions; OTel resource identity
evidence.finding: Local per-feature JSONL/summary artifacts (observability.events) separate from OpenTelemetry traces/metrics (otel_enabled, off unless enabled); defines output-ready, delivered and failure outcomes; installation ID stored locally; no repo names or paths in resource attributes.

evidence.title: Agentico server API
evidence.locator: Discovery And Auth; Parent/Child Relationships; Capability Gates; Supervisor Messages
evidence.finding: Loopback REST/SSE API with owner-only discovery file and bearer token, snapshot-then-subscribe events, parent/child feature relationships, capability gates in testing contracts and supervisor messages; agentico api helper for authenticated calls.

evidence.title: Supervisor background work
evidence.finding: Background work panel lists provider-reported scheduled and event monitors and tasks (e.g. Claude CronCreate); ask-to-stop requires provider acknowledgement; interrupted tasks are not restarted.

evidence.title: Feature state machine
evidence.finding: Durable feature statuses incl. Created, Planning, Implementing, NeedUserInput, ReviewPassed, CodeReady, Published, Done, Failed, Interrupted with an explicit allowed-transition table.

evidence.title: Child features
evidence.finding: Child feature (refactor) relationships under a parent feature with lifecycle, discard and cascade delete.

evidence.title: Work admission
evidence.finding: Reservation-based work admission shared by HTTP entry points, orchestration and session launching, used to close admission during self-update installs.

evidence.title: Configuration schema
evidence.finding: YAML config with defaults.models, exit_criteria, max_iterations, max_consecutive_failures, max_consecutive_no_progress, inquireness, pipeline, repos, workspace_roots and observability settings.

evidence.title: Apache-2.0 license
evidence.finding: Apache License 2.0; contributions need the DoorDash CLA (CLA.md).

evidence.title: README demo animation (agentico-demo-light)
evidence.locator: frames 2-6 Overview; later frames feature workspace and Publish
evidence.finding: First-party GIF of the desktop app: Overview with two running features and one code-ready feature, new-feature wizard with pipeline profiles and checkpoints, a feature workspace with phase progress, elapsed, cost and context, an Ask Agentico panel, and a Publish dialog.

evidence.title: GitHub repository
evidence.finding: doordash-oss/agentic-orchestrator, Apache-2.0, pushed 2026-11-15.

evidence.title: GitHub repository API
evidence.finding: stargazers_count 131, license Apache-2.0, pushed_at 2026-11-15T22:17:58Z.

evidence.title: Release v0.162.0
evidence.finding: Latest release v0.162.0 published 2026-10-30 (commit ea4f920); v0.161.1 on 2026-10-29 and v0.161.0 on 2026-10-12.

evidence.title: Bounded search: schedules and triggers
evidence.finding: The cron/schedule/webhook hits are provider protocol fields, prompt fixtures and the update-check schedule; no user-facing scheduler or webhook trigger for features beyond supervisor monitoring of provider-reported tasks.

evidence.title: Bounded search: issue trackers
evidence.locator: rg -il "linear|jira|github issue|issue tracker" internal/ desktop/src docs/ README.md
evidence.finding: No tracker integration or native issue entity; features are the work unit; gh is used only for PR creation.

evidence.title: Bounded search: users, roles, SSO
evidence.finding: No users, roles, SSO or organizations; one bearer token per server.

evidence.title: Bounded search: sandbox and containers
evidence.finding: Docker appears only as a testing-contract capability gate and release build tool; the Codex backend is started with a coarse sandbox mode (read-only/workspace write) and OpenCode gets a generated permission config; no per-feature container or VM isolation.

evidence.title: Bounded search: certifications
evidence.finding: No SOC 2 or ISO 27001 mention in docs or README.

evidence.title: Bounded search: billing
evidence.finding: No pricing page or billing code; only codex-pricing.md (model price tables for cost estimates).

evidence.title: Desktop quit coordinator
evidence.finding: When active work exists, quitting offers Keep Running (hides the window and leaves work attached), Stop Work and Quit (sends stop requests before shutdown) or Cancel.

evidence.title: Desktop main process shutdown
evidence.locator: shutdown handler near line 1031-1056: app-owned runtime stopped via gateway.shutdown()
evidence.finding: On quit the app stops a runtime it owns (app-owned) with gateway.shutdown(); a runtime the app does not own is released without being stopped.

evidence.title: Session watchdog defaults
evidence.finding: Sessions get idle-silence watchdogs: 5 minutes while a tool is pending, 30 minutes while a subagent task is pending and 5 minutes after tools finish before the turn completes; no overall wall-clock cap was found.

changes.author: agent:ADE-102
changes.summary: Independent review corrections: quitting the desktop app stops an app-owned runtime (quitCoordinator, shutdown handler), so 'runs continue independent of the app window' was overstated; code has idle-silence watchdog timeouts, so 'no time limits/timeouts' was incomplete.

before.answer: Runs on your machine or on a host you run `agentico server` on, attached from the desktop app by connection string; runs continue in the server independent of the app window; no managed cloud. Network mode is plain HTTP with a bearer token and expects a trusted network, VPN or SSH tunnel.

after.answer: Runs on your machine or on a host you run `agentico server` on, attached from the desktop app by connection string; with the default app-owned local server, work continues only while the app is open (Keep Running hides the window; Stop Work and Quit stops it), while a separately started `agentico server` is its own process whose behavior when an attached app quits is not documented; no managed cloud. Network mode is plain HTTP with a bearer token and expects a trusted network, VPN or SSH tunnel.
